outcome: Ovarian reserve (mean ovary diameter, antral follicle count, anti-Mullerian hormone levels)
Endocrine function indicators (estradiol, progesterone, luteinizing hormone, follicle-stimulating hormone levels)
cohort: The study included 60 patients diagnosed with Cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP).
finding: Laparoscopic temporary uterine artery blocking (TUAB) followed by cesarean scar lesion repair (CSLR) was found to be a more effective and safer treatment for cesarean scar pregnancy than uterine artery embolization (UAE) followed by CSLR.
